blockers.title: failClosedNoAppend has no durable per-carrier representation for restore and loss recovery.
blockers.finding: terminalization.failClosedNoAppend correctly avoids an unsafe append after witnessless restore, loss/capacity, or overturn, but then says the durable fact that keeps the carrier fail-closed is that standing itself. The standing is a generic rule in this artifact, not a durable instance fact identifying a particular carrier. In the witnessless-restore counterexample, the restored journal cannot safely receive REV or a terminal marker because its true tail is unknown; v8 mints no witness or second marker and assigns no separate quarantine/invalidity byte. After a subsequent crash, recovery has only the stale, internally valid journal. permission-truth-tables.v6 therefore replays its apparent tail and resumes at last-durable-plus-one; no durable REV or marker tells it to refuse. The same gap affects a past storage-loss/capacity event once the immediate condition is no longer observable. FROZEN-UNDER-OVERTURN may be derivable from a global applied overturn, but that does not make the other per-carrier events durable. This leaves the durable, classed-fact portion of SCC-V7-B2 unfolded while appliesFindingsOf claims none remain.
blockers.requiredRepair: Define how each carrier state is recovered from declared durable authority. Make healthy TERMINAL derive solely from its journal terminal marker, avoiding an unassigned second state byte. For witnessless restore or uncertain tail loss, either reject promotion of the restored carrier and keep it in an immutable/quarantined namespace whose class, owner, sole writer, retention, backup, purge, migration, and recovery rules are assigned, or persist an external fail-closed carrier record with that complete DR-124 treatment; do not append it to the stale journal. Distinguish temporary capacity refusal with an intact proven tail from permanent uncertain-tail quarantine. Name the existing applied source that derives FROZEN-UNDER-OVERTURN. Until this is closed, list SCC-V7-B2 as not folded rather than treating the word standing as durable storage.
